headline: Reddit’s AI is turning posts into podcasts and short videos
summary: Reddit is experimenting with AI to convert text posts into audio and video. Some posts are being adapted into videos using AI voices to read content. This initiative aims to offer new ways for users to consume content.

headline: ABC's livestreamed news show is powered by trending topics
summary: ABC News launched 'Searched', a new livestreamed show. It highlights stories trending on social media and web searches. The show airs on ABC News Live, including Disney Plus.

headline: This compact Glorious mechanical keyboard is just $35
summary: The 65-percent Glorious GMMK 3 mechanical keyboard is on sale for $34.99 at Woot. This deal is perfect for those curious about custom mechanical keyboards. Use coupon code WOOTGAMING at checkout for the discount.

headline: Wordle meets Clippy in this new word game
summary: A new word game called Dartwords combines elements of Wordle and Clippy. Designed by Sam Rosenthal, it offers a fresh take on daily word puzzles. The game encourages players to chase good scores and share results.

headline: The Practical ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor Is on Sale From Newegg via AliExpress
summary: The ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor is currently on sale. It doubles as a secondary monitor for your laptop. This monitor is also a portable display for devices like Nintendo Switch or Steam Deck.

headline: James Gunn Defends the Tonal Shift of the DCU After Lanterns Stirs Conversation With Gritty First Episode
summary: James Gunn, DC Studios co-CEO, defended the DCU's evolving tonal shifts. His comments follow discussions about the gritty first episode of 'Lanterns'. Gunn clarified that the DCU will not maintain a uniform tone.

headline: Amazon's Game of Thrones T-Shirt Sale Has Some Great House of the Dragon Designs
summary: Amazon is currently running a sale on Game of Thrones t-shirts. The collection features several appealing designs inspired by House of the Dragon. Fans can find various apparel items from the popular fantasy series.

headline: The 65" Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV Drops to $1,198 with Free Shipping on Amazon
summary: The 65-inch Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV is now priced at $1,198. This deal includes free shipping when purchased on Amazon. The S90F was previously recognized as the best gaming TV in 2026.

headline: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
summary: IVF clinics in northern Cyprus face accusations of misleading UK parents. Multiple children are feared to have been conceived with unselected donors. Concerns are rising over transparency in donor information.

headline: Russia says UK 'will pay' for supplying drones to Ukraine
summary: Russia issued a stern warning to the UK over its supply of drones to Ukraine. Moscow stated Britain 'will pay' for its support to Kyiv. The UK's MoD affirmed its continued solidarity with Ukraine.

headline: Fifa official sacked after Infantino plan criticism
summary: Senior Fifa figure Kevin Lamour has been sacked by football's governing body. His dismissal occurred three weeks after he publicly criticized President Gianni Infantino. The incident highlights internal discord within Fifa leadership.

headline: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
summary: German authorities conducted raids targeting gangs involved in small boat smuggling. Police seized dinghies and life jackets from a secret warehouse. These operations are part of a new law to crack down on human trafficking.
